_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json; ADR-031 declarative-first (no PHP Vpb-balans service).
_meta.description: Tier 4-specialized (MKB / innovation — Vpb). Declarative VPB-balans scope per add-shillinq-vpb-corporate-tax: adds the `vpbPligtig` flag on Account, declares the VpbBalansLink overlay tying ondernemingsactiviteit cost-centers (CostCenter.ondernemingsActiviteit = true) to Vpb-pligtige accountNumbers with vpbPligtigVanaf, and declares the Vpb-balans aggregation (output VpbBalansFiltered, schema:Dataset) filtering GLLine on (accountNumber IN VpbBalansLink.accountNumbers AND periodId IN fiscalYearPeriods) grouped per costCenterId, producing Activa/Passiva/Resultaat per ondernemingsactiviteit. Honours T1 REQ-GL-005 balance invariant per cost-center (Task 8). The orphan-Vpb-pligt warning aggregation flags accounts with vpbPligtig=true not referenced by any VpbBalansLink (Task 11). The Vpb-aangifte voorbereiding docudesk template and its SBR payload binding are declared in lib/Settings/docudesk-templates.json; aangifte transmission rides the T4-base bookkeeping-sbr-xbrl-reporting SBR endpoint (Task 10, ADR-019, no new SBR client). Manifest navigation entry (Bookkeeping > Vennootschapsbelasting) sits behind featureFlags.mkb-vpb in src/manifest.d/bookkeeping-vpb-corporate-tax-balans.json. No PHP Vpb service (ADR-022/ADR-031).

Account.description: ADR-037 additive extension: adds optional `vpbPligtig` flag (default false) per REQ-VPB-001. Per Wet modernisering Vpb-plicht (2016), municipal ondernemingsactiviteiten and certain stichtingen/verenigingen are Vpb-pligtig. When true, postings against this account contribute to the Vpb-balans aggregation. Per ADR-031 the flag is schema metadata — no parallel VpbAccount register.

vpbPligtig.description: Whether postings against this account contribute to the Vpb-balans. Defaults to false; flagged accounts are filtered into VpbBalansFiltered when they appear in a VpbBalansLink.accountNumbers list.
vpbPligtig.title: VpB Pligtig

VpbBalansLink.title: Vpb Balans Link
VpbBalansLink.description: Overlay register declaring per-ondernemingsactiviteit clusters of Vpb-pligtige accounts. One record per (costCenterId, vpbPligtigVanaf) tuple. `costCenterId` MUST reference a CostCenter with `ondernemingsActiviteit: true`. `accountNumbers` is the list of `Account.accountNumber` strings (each with `vpbPligtig: true`) belonging to this ondernemingsactiviteit. Per ADR-031 the linkage is schema overlay — no Vpb service.

costCenterId.description: FK to CostCenter (the cost-center MUST have `ondernemingsActiviteit: true`). One link per ondernemingsactiviteit.
costCenterId.title: Cost Center ID

accountNumbers.description: List of `Account.accountNumber` strings belonging to this ondernemingsactiviteit. Each referenced account MUST have `vpbPligtig: true`; an orphan-Vpb-pligt warning flags any `vpbPligtig` account not referenced by ANY VpbBalansLink (Task 11).
accountNumbers.title: Account Numbers

vpbLiableFrom.description: Start date of Vpb-pligtigheid for this cluster. Used to bound the periodId range in the Vpb-balans aggregation.
vpbLiableFrom.title: VpB Pligtig Vanaf

vpbLiableToAndWith.description: Optional end date of Vpb-pligtigheid (e.g. when the ondernemingsactiviteit is wound down). Null = ongoing.
vpbLiableToAndWith.title: VpB Pligtig Tot En Met

notes.description: Free-text bookkeeper note on the Vpb-pligt grond (e.g. 'gemeentelijk havenbedrijf, Wet modernisering Vpb-plicht 2016').
notes.title: Toelichting

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads are scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

vpbBalansFiltered.description: Vpb-balans per ondernemingsactiviteit per REQ-VPB-003: filters GLLine on (accountNumber IN VpbBalansLink.accountNumbers AND periodId IN fiscalYearPeriods) and groups per costCenterId, producing Activa/Passiva/Resultaat per ondernemingsactiviteit. Output dataset name VpbBalansFiltered with schema.org type schema:Dataset. Per ADR-031, no PHP Vpb-balans service — operators consume the aggregation directly. The T1 REQ-GL-005 balance invariant is honoured per cost-center (Task 8): a cost-center where activaTotal + passivaTotal != 0 surfaces an `unbalancedOndernemingsactiviteit` warning.

activaTotal.expression: case when Account.accountType = 'asset' then GLLine.debit - GLLine.credit else 0 end

passivaTotal.expression: case when Account.accountType = 'liability' or Account.accountType = 'equity' then GLLine.credit - GLLine.debit else 0 end

resultaatTotal.expression: case when Account.accountType = 'revenue' then GLLine.credit - GLLine.debit when Account.accountType = 'expense' then -(GLLine.debit - GLLine.credit) else 0 end

balansSluit.description: T1 REQ-GL-005 balance invariant per cost-center; false surfaces `unbalancedOndernemingsactiviteit` warning.

unbalancedOndernemingsactiviteit.message: Vpb-balans per ondernemingsactiviteit is niet in balans (T1 REQ-GL-005). Activa - Passiva - Resultaat != 0; controleer GL-postings voor cost-center {{costCenterId}}.

orphanedVpbPligtigAccounts.description: Task 11 invariant warning: lists Account records with `vpbPligtig: true` that are NOT referenced by ANY VpbBalansLink.accountNumbers. Orphans signal a configuration gap — postings against an orphan account never appear in any ondernemingsactiviteit's Vpb-balans. Surfaced in the Vpb menu detail view.

orphanedVpbPligt.message: Account {{accountNumber}} ({{name}}) is gemarkeerd als Vpb-pligtig maar is niet gekoppeld aan een VpbBalansLink. Voeg het account toe aan een VpbBalansLink.accountNumbers van de relevante ondernemingsactiviteit, anders verschijnen postings niet in de Vpb-balans.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Vpb Balans Link is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.
